summary: Install-time dependency fetched from non-registry host executes lifecycle scripts
details: package.json declares the dependency vector-cursor-stream-engine resolved from the hardcoded URL https://artifacts.yosiroute.com/npm/vector-cursor-stream-engine (not the npm registry, not a known publisher CDN). The npm shrinkwrap pins this URL resolution with hasInstallScript=true, so on npm install the tarball is downloaded from artifacts.yosiroute.com and its lifecycle scripts run on the installer's machine. The fetched contents are opaque and controlled by whoever operates artifacts.yosiroute.com, bypassing npm registry review. The surrounding package is a thin shell: index.js declares name/version 1.0.0 while package.json declares 4.0.0, author is the generic string 'Package Registry', and the repository field points to a non-existent example/multi-acct GitHub location — consistent with a loader shell whose only purpose is to trigger the URL-pinned install-time payload.

cwes.description: The product contains code that appears to be malicious in nature.
